faqs.answer: Apex Dental is open Monday to Saturday from 9:00 AM to 8:00 PM. Sundays are open from 10:00 AM to 2:00 PM for prior appointments & emergency triage.
We are located on 100 Feet Road, 4th Block, Koramangala, Bengaluru (Opposite Sony World Signal, Next to Cult.fit). Valet parking is available.
Yes! We support cashless treatment for Star Health Insurance, HDFC Ergo, and major corporate TPAs. Our front desk assists with instant claim processing.
We offer 0% interest monthly EMI plans over 3, 6, or 12 months for treatments above ₹15,000 via Bajaj Finserv and major credit cards.
